audit_metadata.phase: Phase 4.5: Sealed Test Vault Security and Evaluation Boundary Audit
audit_metadata.auditor_role: Senior Python Software Architect & ML Evaluation Engineer

environment.user_execution_model: Single user account (HP) with standard NTFS filesystem access
environment.privilege_separation: Procedural software boundary within Python; no OS-level daemon or separate user account

plaintext_sequences_and_labels.details: Holdout records are stored as plaintext JSON objects with raw nucleotide sequences and cancer labels.

ordinary_training_script_access.status_before: VULNERABLE (load_samples could read holdout JSON if path provided)
ordinary_training_script_access.status_after: PROTECTED (validate_not_sealed_vault_path raises PermissionError on load_samples, load_csv, load_json, load_jsonl)

bypass_without_sealed_vault.status: POSSIBLE via standard OS read calls (open, json.load, Get-Content)
bypass_without_sealed_vault.classification: Inherent limitation of local workspace architecture; documented as procedural boundary

state_persistence_across_restarts.mechanism: Persistent JSON state file at artifacts/vault/vault_state.json with status LOCKED or UNSEALED

state_deletion_or_modification_reset.status_before: VULNERABLE (deleting vault_state.json caused is_locked() to return True)
state_deletion_or_modification_reset.status_after: PROTECTED (is_locked() and verify_integrity() detect missing state file on initialized vault and raise DataValidationError)

checksum_tampering_detection.status: PROTECTED (verify_integrity(), unseal(), and FinalHoldoutEvaluator verify SHA-256 against manifest before returning data)

concurrency_race_condition.status: MITIGATED (atomic write via os.replace on temporary state file; architectural policy restricts evaluation to single process)

silent_fallback_vulnerability.status: PROTECTED (load_development_cohort raises FileNotFoundError immediately if development cohort is missing; zero fallback)

development_interface.restrictions: Rejects any path in artifacts/vault; verifies development SHA-256 against manifest

enforced_checks: Model configuration explicitly marked as frozen (is_frozen == True)
Development cohort SHA-256 verified against manifest (7c35fc4f...)
Holdout file SHA-256 verified against manifest (430a2e6f...)
Vault procedural lock confirmed active (is_locked == True)
One-shot evaluation enforcement (repeated calls raise PermissionError)
Append-only event audit logging to artifacts/vault/evaluation_events.jsonl

recommended_production_enhancements.name: Air-Gapped External Storage
recommended_production_enhancements.description: Store holdout data in an external system directory or restricted cloud bucket injected only during CI release.

recommended_production_enhancements.name: Envelope Encryption (AES-256-GCM)
recommended_production_enhancements.description: Encrypt holdout payload with key held out-of-band by an evaluation gatekeeper or KMS.

recommended_production_enhancements.name: Evaluation Microservice API
recommended_production_enhancements.description: Submit model weights/inference endpoint to an isolated evaluation server that never exposes raw test sequences.
